note: Deep-dive #15. Run order: phase 1 seed, adf-runs (run 1; between runs seed phase 2 and trigger, then trigger with nothing new), quality (phase 3 + one more run, prepared in the screen's prepare), score, powerbi. All data is synthetic: say it on screen once.
prepare: python -m pip install -q -r requirements.txt; python -m pytest -q
Invoke-Pester ./tests
# owner signs in (device code), not recorded
az login --use-device-code
az provider register -n Microsoft.Synapse; az provider register -n Microsoft.DataFactory; az extension add -n datafactory --only-show-errors
az group create -n rg-mglab-deep-dive-15 -l westeurope -o none
$me = az ad signed-in-user show --query "{upn:userPrincipalName,oid:id}" -o json | ConvertFrom-Json; $ip = Invoke-RestMethod https://api.ipify.org
$o = az deployment group create -g rg-mglab-deep-dive-15 -f infra/main.bicep -p "adminLogin=$($me.upn)" "adminObjectId=$($me.oid)" "clientIp=$ip" --query properties.outputs -o json | ConvertFrom-Json
$env:MG_STORAGE15 = $o.storageAccountName.value; $env:MG_SQL15 = $o.sqlServerFqdn.value; $env:MG_ADF15 = $o.dataFactoryName.value; $env:MG_SYN15 = $o.synapseServerlessEndpoint.value
# manual: Synapse Studio > Manage > Access control: confirm labadmin is Synapse Administrator; role assignments can take a few minutes
Import-Module ./scripts/AnalyticsLab.psm1 -Force
$src = Get-AnalyticsSqlPlan -Target Source -FactoryName $env:MG_ADF15
Invoke-AnalyticsSql -Server $env:MG_SQL15 -Plan $src -WhatIf
Invoke-AnalyticsSql -Server $env:MG_SQL15 -Plan $src
$env:PYTHONPATH = 'src'; python -m analytics seed-sql --phase 1 --out "$env:TEMP\phase1.sql"
sqlcmd -S $env:MG_SQL15 -d sourcedb -G -b -i "$env:TEMP\phase1.sql"   # 1,089 rows; do NOT run the pipeline yet
$syn = Get-AnalyticsSqlPlan -Target Synapse -StorageAccount $env:MG_STORAGE15
Invoke-AnalyticsSql -Server $env:MG_SYN15 -Plan $syn   # views exist before any file does

screens.name: adf-runs
steps: Data Factory Studio (factory name masked) > Author: show pipeline pl_incremental_purchase_requests once (four activities)
Trigger now (Debug is fine); Monitor > Pipeline runs: first run succeeded; open the Copy activity details: rows read 1,089
Off camera cut: python -m analytics seed-sql --phase 2 --out $env:TEMP\phase2.sql ; sqlcmd -S $env:MG_SQL15 -d sourcedb -G -b -i $env:TEMP\phase2.sql ; then trigger again: rows read 145
Trigger again with nothing new: rows read 0
Portal > the storage account > Containers > lake > bronze/purchase_requests/ingest_date=<day>/: the three requests-<run id>.parquet files

screens.name: quality
prepare: $env:PYTHONPATH = 'src'; python -m analytics seed-sql --phase 3 --out "$env:TEMP\phase3.sql"; sqlcmd -S $env:MG_SQL15 -d sourcedb -G -b -i "$env:TEMP\phase3.sql"
$run = az datafactory pipeline create-run --factory-name $env:MG_ADF15 -g rg-mglab-deep-dive-15 --name pl_incremental_purchase_requests --query runId -o tsv

do { Start-Sleep -Seconds 15; $st = az datafactory pipeline-run show --factory-name $env:MG_ADF15 -g rg-mglab-deep-dive-15 --run-id $run --query status -o tsv } while ($st -in 'Queued','InProgress')   # rows read 4
steps: Connect to the Synapse serverless endpoint with Microsoft Entra MFA as labadmin, database contoso_analytics
Run: SELECT * FROM quality.CheckResult  (bronze row versions greater than distinct requests; four rejected rows: NonPositiveAmount, UnknownDepartment, ApprovedBeforeSubmitted, UnknownStatus)
Run: SELECT * FROM sys.dm_external_data_processed  (how little data the queries processed)
mask: serverless endpoint name in the connection dialog and tab titles

screens.name: score
commands: # every number on this screen comes from SYNTHETIC purchase requests, not real people
sqlcmd -S $env:MG_SYN15 -d contoso_analytics -G -Q "SELECT TOP 10 RequestId, BreachProbability FROM gold.RequestRiskScore WHERE Status = 'Submitted' ORDER BY BreachProbability DESC"
also: The SELECT TOP 10 runs with sqlcmd in the same terminal instead of switching to SSMS. Expect auc_test and brier_test below brier_baseline_constant from train, PSI about 0.02 from drift. Storage account and endpoint stay in environment variables.

screens.name: powerbi
steps: Get data > Azure Synapse Analytics SQL: server = the serverless -ondemand endpoint, database contoso_analytics, Import mode, sign in with the Microsoft account (labadmin)
Navigator: tick gold.FactPurchaseRequest, gold.DimDepartment and gold.RequestRiskScore, Load
Model view: relationship FactPurchaseRequest[DepartmentKey] to DimDepartment[DepartmentKey], many to one
Visual 1: clustered bar, Average of CycleDays by DepartmentName
Visual 2: table of RequestId, Amount, BreachProbability filtered to Status = Submitted, sorted descending by BreachProbability
Do not publish; do not show the server name
mask: server name in the Get data dialog, Data source settings and Power Query editor

teardown: Remove-Item Env:MG_STORAGE15, Env:MG_SQL15, Env:MG_ADF15, Env:MG_SYN15, Env:PYTHONPATH -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
